description: Source code for NodeServiceManager, managing node service start/stop commands, executing shell commands, parsing JSON responses, and logging errors.

classes.name: CommandResult
classes.description: Holds the result of executing a service command, including success status, payload, message, and parsed JSON.

classes.name: ParsedServiceJson
classes.description: Represents parsed JSON response from the service, including status, message, error, and hints.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Asynchronously starts the node service, returns error message if failed.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Asynchronously stops the node service, returns error message if failed.

methods.name: serviceCommand
methods.description: Constructs the command to manage the node service with given arguments.

methods.name: runServiceCommandResult
methods.description: Executes the service command asynchronously, parses output, and returns a CommandResult.

methods.name: errorMessage
methods.description: Generates an error message based on command result and loading status.

methods.name: withJsonFlag
methods.description: Ensures '--json' flag is included in command arguments.

methods.name: parseServiceJson
methods.description: Parses JSON output from service response into ParsedServiceJson object.

methods.name: mergeHints
methods.description: Combines error message and hints into a single string.

methods.name: summarize
methods.description: Summarizes the last line of a text for error reporting.
